head: 4af7cf3c233c374767ce9831356bc4905271d137
decision: Do not merge yet. Exact-head distributed recovery validation is incomplete.

reviewed_risk_paths: Sequencer canonical confirmation and retry ordering
Mirror durable recovery marker and incomplete scan handling
Egress retention floor and finalized L1 observation
scope.limit: Risk-focused review and source ancestry audit, not a new line-by-line audit of all 636 files.

findings.finding: Coverage pins one primary before polling and propagates a transient observation error out of the 120-second recovery wait. Redis failover between discovery and HMGET can end the case early.
findings.observed: All mirrors reported Complete, then HMGET timed out after 20 seconds. Underlying cause of that timeout is not established.

findings.finding: The executor job ended near its two-hour limit after chaos and persisted-state checks passed, before the L1 rebuild audit completed. The final candidate lacks that recovery proof.
findings.action: Measure phase durations and preserve the full audit. Do not infer an L1 reconstruction failure or pass from job cancellation.
findings.phase_timing: deploy-broken-image runs from 10:45:09Z to 11:47:23Z (62m14s): failed deploy returns at 11:13:38Z, healing converges at 11:46:32Z. Persisted-state comparison passes at 11:48:38Z; reconstruction starts at 11:48:59Z; cancellation follows at 11:49:18Z.

findings.finding: The local head observer unwraps a single Redis timeout before its overall five-second recovery budget expires.
findings.observed: The cold-mirror case fails at this unwrap in the current component matrix. Other mirror cases pass.

validation.integrity_on_final_head: No evidence in the current run; suite=all qualification remains required.

local_component_checks.scope: Integration head plus unpublished transport test; production transport unchanged.

validation.formats: Pass with declared notifier retirement and feature-gated seed format activation.

hot_path: Experimental transport wait changes are excluded. Paired measurements reduce CPU but leave a throughput regression unresolved.
rollout: Require empty notifier outbox before the explicit retirement allowance.
Activate seed-format feature only after all nodes can read version 2.
Older mirrors ignore the recovery marker; rollback during incomplete recovery requires explicit rebuild.

followup_validation.scope: Local observer fixes and independent transport recovery test. Distributed validation is pending; the initial 169/170 failure above is retained as evidence.

current_integration_after_followups.review: Direct Redis coverage reads refresh discovery and validate ROLE on their read connection. Executor outer job budget is 180 minutes; individual case and reconstruction deadlines are unchanged.
current_integration_after_followups.ci: Fresh CI pending; no main merge or qualification credit.
